key_insight: An anatomy-aware 3D GAN improved brain MRI inpainting over a simple 3D AutoEncoder but did not outperform the challenge’s Pix2Pix3D baseline.
clinical_relevance: This imaging research synthesizes plausible healthy-appearing tissue in tumor-masked regions; it does not establish drug-discovery utility or clinical benefit.
method: Combines mask-aware gated convolutions, mirrored contralateral context, and attention-modulated skip fusion.
Uses boundary-aware refinement and a local masked-region refiner.
Trains with reconstruction objectives followed by low-weight adversarial fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: Official BraTS 2026 Task 4 evaluation across 219 cases yielded mean SSIM 0.658 and mean PSNR 14.81 dB, below local held-out results.
watch_item: Controlled ablations are still needed to isolate the contributions of mirrored context and the two-stage training schedule.
paper_title: Anatomy-Aware 3D GAN with Local Mask Refinement for Brain MRI Inpainting
